metadata.notes: The one byproduct common to both of egg.json's spawning actions — PEEL (shell off a boiled egg) and SEPARATE (cracking a raw egg) — hence it's egg.json's flat producedByproducts fallback, with byproductsByAction only overriding SEPARATE to add egg_yolk + egg_white on top. Unlike potato_peel.json, marked non-reusable: no fry/mix-equivalent reuse path modeled for it.
